current_evidence: Not established. The council's 'Planning Validation Checklists (2018)' page loaded but showed no links or dates. The PDF could not be fetched, and searches could not be run because the shared WebFetch/WebSearch budget ran out, so I could not confirm that no newer local list replaces the Jan 2020 revision.

issues.detail: The workbook link is the council's single checklist for 'Full, Outline, Reserved Matters and Removal or Variation of Condition' applications (per its file name), yet Outline, Reserved matters and Variation of condition s73 are all marked '(none) - no specific local requirements'. Every local requirement was placed only under Full planning, mostly as 'INFERRED'. The same requirements should be shown for Outline/RM/s73 as the checklist sets them out.
issues.evidence: Workbook URL file name 'full_outline_reserve_matters_and_removal_or_variation_of_condition.pdf'; app rows Outline/Reserved matters/s73 = '(none)'

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none)' even though Grokbot read the householder checklist (householder.pdf) and took drawing standards from it (scale bar, annotated materials). Its local requirements were never turned into Householder rows.

Rows from separate type-specific checklists are filed under the wrong application type. listed_building.pdf items (window schedule of works, archaeology) appear under Full planning. Under Listed building consent, the 'Block plan' and 'Schedule of works' rows quote the demolition requirements from the full/outline checklist (site plan of structures to be demolished, demolition method statement and management plan). Rows from prior_approval_-_demolition.pdf (Ecological/Bat survey) appear under 'Change of use - prior approval' instead of prior approval for demolition, and its Structural Survey appears under Full planning. Land Contamination appears under 'Minerals & waste (county)', but Manchester is a metropolitan borough with no county minerals tier, and the text is the general full/outline land contamination item.
issues.evidence: Rows: 'Listed building consent | Schedule of works | ...A method statement for the proposed demolition works. A demolition management plan'; 'Minerals & waste (county) | Contaminated Land ... site investigation survey of ground contamination'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or carry another item's text. Flood Risk ('to provide a Flood Risk Assessment.'), Ecology ('trees, then a bat survey will be required.'), Floor plans ('and coloured elevations.'), Tall buildings ('guidance on 'Tall Buildings'.') and Viability are bare fragments with no trigger. Advertisement/illumination runs into the 'Local Labour Agreement' item. Travel Plan runs into 'Ventilation, Extraction and odour'. 'Street scene elevations' is actually the demolition-justification criteria. 'Housing mix' repeats the Affordable Housing text, losing the 15+ dwellings trigger. The prior-approval 'Ecological Survey' trigger is about EIA screening ('Manchester City Council has to determine if an Environmental Impact Assessment will be required').
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts, e.g. '...(Core Strategy Policy DM1) Local Labour Agreement Details of a Local Employment Agreement which should contain a commitment to work with the Work and Skills Team...'

issues.detail: Local Labour / Local Employment Agreement (commitment to work with the Work and Skills Team) appears in the checklist text Grokbot extracted but has no requirement row. A full check for other missing items (e.g. air quality, daylight/sunlight, waste management, TV reception) was not possible because the PDF could not be fetched.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Local Labour Agreement Details of a Local Employment Agreement which should contain a commitment to work with the Work and Skills Team to ensure that employment opportunities resulting from this devel...'

issues.detail: Affordable Housing Statement, Housing mix and Viability Assessment are three rows built from the same Core Strategy H8 paragraph (15+ dwellings). The housing mix and viability points are parts of the Affordable Housing Statement, not separate requirements.
issues.evidence: 'Affordable Housing Statement On schemes for 15 or more dwellings (Core Strategy Policy H8)... Where no affordable housing is being proposed, a full un-redacted viability assessment will be submitted'

issues.detail: One tab_item carries page-header junk ('Revised September 2018 Page 1 of 3' and empty bullets) in front of the listed-building drawing requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'Revised September 2018 Page 1 of 3 · · Accurate, annotated drawings detailing internal works...'

issues.detail: The list is from Jan 2020 (other Manchester checklists say 'Revised September 2018', and the landing page is titled 'Planning Validation Checklists (2018)'). It cites NPPF 2019 paragraph numbers and cannot include post-2020 requirements such as mandatory BNG or Fire Statements. Whether Manchester has published a newer list needs checking. The budget ran out before it could be confirmed.
issues.evidence: Reference row Date basis 'text: Revised January 2020'; NPPF 'paragraph 97', 'paragraph 180', 'paragraphs 178-179' cited in excerpts

summary: The current link and the source contents could not be verified because the shared web budget ran out; the council's 2018 validation checklists page loaded but showed nothing useful. Grokbot's own data shows clear errors: Householder, Outline, RM and s73 are wrongly marked as having no local requirements, rows are mixed up across the demolition, listed-building and prior-approval checklists, and many triggers are fragments.
